title: 2k/3 Shuumatsu no Kami // God of the End (Episode 1 and spin-off available)

posts.author: Ishatee
posts.body:
Hello RPG Maker community!
After deciding dedicate more time and effort on my projects, I come here to announce my first serious project...
I'm trying to see this as a work, so to speak.
Well, I'm not good with presentations, but I'll try my best to make this topic interesting!
Hope you like the game proposal, and let's go!
Shuumatsu no Kami
.
Disclaimer: This game can have sensitive topics to some players like violence and disturbing imagery which, even though do not appear in this demo, will appear during the development of the game. With that said, its recommended to have, at least, 13 years to play the game​
SYNOPSIS
Spoiler
In a cursed world,
During the wars between two species looking for supremacy,
Some stories iterlace...
A young nobleman finds himself imprisoned on his own house infested by bizarre creatures;
A wolf starts killing noble humans who wants to exterminate youkai;
And other stories...
Shuumatsu no Kami tells how all these individuals are connected and how their fates can decide the future of the world. Blessings and Curses get mixed into an ambiguous form...
Game Characters until now
Kevin - A young nobleman. His father has died some months ago and now he has the duty to mantain the honor of his family.
Raizou - A wolf youkai. Was adopted by Kevin when he was still a cub. They thought Raizou was a dog.
Game Characters in future updates
Kaede - Another Wolf youkai. Has an extreme hatred for humans until he became friends with Chaldea.
Chaldea - A human girl. Apparently has a mysterious past, but won't tell to anyone.
* More Coming soon... *
Organizations and worldbuilding aspects
Mankind Supremacy - A radical organization developed by noble humans. Wants to exterminate all youkais and expand the humanity territory over the world.
God Hand - A cult who tries to communicate with god. A more deviant vertent wants to create a god by itself to guide both mankind and youkai to a better future.
Extermination Squad - An android organization created by scientists. Wants to erradicate the world conflicts by killing the actual leaders and governments
Game Features
Simple ABS combat
Logic puzzles
Game is planned to have Multiple endings based on the player choices
